description: A sample module (development_plan.md 4.8): a Lantern component and commands written in Lua, with no C++.

components.name: Lantern
components.description: A light source: how far its light reaches and whether it's lit.

fields.name: radius
fields.description: How far the light reaches, in cells.

commands.name: lantern.setAll
commands.description: Lights or puts out every lantern in the scene.

params.name: lit
params.description: true to light them, false to put them out

commands.name: lantern.scaleRadius
commands.description: Multiplies every lantern's radius (clamped to its range).

params.name: factor
params.description: 1.5 makes them reach half again as far
